purpose: Canonicalize the existing iPhone Flow shortcuts from recovered current artifacts without inventing replacements.

policy.shared_logic_rule: Reuse existing child Shortcuts/adapters; do not copy common processing between Flows.
policy.empty_flow_rule: A recovered Flow with zero actions remains a safe no-op until an evidenced implementation exists.
policy.appliance_automation_rule: Home / Out appliance automation is owned by Tapo H110 Geofencing; Scriptable MY REMOTE remains manual/fallback and must not be auto-opened.

selection_basis: This supplied artifact was authored by the newer Shortcuts client 5037.109 with minimum client 5001.
It has no embedded Focus trigger, which matches the already-verified ProjectY parent Morning orchestration path.
It extends the evidenced Morning behavior with destination/travel/departure calculations while preserving the same urgency output model.

factory.reason: Recompiling or re-signing would replace the recovered iPhone implementation instead of canonicalizing it.

runtime_contract.trigger: Existing parent Shortcut Morning is the canonical caller; the parent Morning path is already verified in ProjectY production evidence.
actions: Find the next Calendar event beginning within the next 1 day and read title, start date, and location.
Calculate the remaining time from now until the event starts.
When a location exists, calculate travel time, apply a 10-minute arrival buffer, derive arrival and departure targets, and calculate time until departure.
Return one of the existing urgency outputs: ○余裕あり, △準備開始, or ●急ぐ; the latter two also vibrate.
When location is absent, use the parallel urgency branches without travel fields.
When no event exists, return ○予定なし.
runtime_contract.focus_relation: Focus gating belongs to the existing parent Morning path. The canonical Morning Flow itself intentionally has no embedded Focus trigger.
runtime_contract.duplicate_prevention: Use this triggerless canonical Morning Flow only through the existing parent Morning path. The older supplied Morning variant with an embedded Morning Focus-enable trigger is historical/non-canonical and must not also run.
runtime_contract.failure_safe: Calendar/travel/date reads, output text, variables, and vibration only. No persistent write, deletion, message send, payment, purchase, or data migration exists in this Flow. Missing event/location follows explicit safe branches.

runtime_contract.focus_relation: Runs when the Home Focus is enabled.
runtime_contract.duplicate_prevention: Only this recovered canonical artifact is adopted; no second Home automation is added. Because there are zero actions, repeated execution has no runtime side effects.
runtime_contract.failure_safe: The recovered Shortcut itself remains a zero-action safe baseline. Appliance automation is externalized to Tapo. Arrival turns on only the floor lamp in v1; the main white ceiling light, AC, and TV remain manual/excluded.

external_automation.reason: Arrival should create a comfortable atmosphere without forcing the white ceiling light on. Floor lamp is automatic; the main white light remains manual.

physical_verification.evidence: Owner verified a real arrival after leaving home; floor lamp automation worked with no reported problem.

runtime_contract.focus_relation: Runs when the Work Focus is enabled.
runtime_contract.duplicate_prevention: Only this recovered canonical artifact is adopted; no second Work automation is added. Because there are zero actions, repeated execution has no runtime side effects.
runtime_contract.failure_safe: Zero actions. The current evidenced implementation is a safe no-op and is not filled with guessed behavior.

runtime_contract.focus_relation: Runs when the Out Focus is enabled.
runtime_contract.duplicate_prevention: Only this recovered canonical artifact is adopted; no second Out automation is added. Because there are zero actions, repeated execution has no runtime side effects.
runtime_contract.failure_safe: The recovered Shortcut itself remains a zero-action safe baseline. Tapo owns appliance shutdown. Any ambiguous TV power-toggle is excluded because it could turn an already-off TV on.

conditional_actions: TV OFF only when the actual Tapo action is a discrete OFF command, never a power toggle
external_automation.reason: Departure automation must still execute after the iPhone disconnects from home Wi-Fi and must not depend on Scriptable.

physical_verification.evidence: Owner verified a real departure; floor lamp, main light, and air conditioner shutdown worked with no reported problem.
